title: backlog check warns on every tools item that code.md, mapped to _tools/*.py, is in no item's touches
goal: backlog.py check's docs warning no longer names kb/_self/code.md for an item merely because it touches a _tools/*.py file, while selfdoc stale still lists code.md after a tools change so the rules are reviewed (a Self-Reviewed trailer clears it); the warnings count returns to the items whose own docs are missing, and a test in _tools/test_backlog.py plants a tools item with no code.md in any touches and sees no code.md warning

run: import subprocess,sys;o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','check'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;n=o.count('kb/_self/code.md');assert n==0,str(n)+' items warned about kb/_self/code.md'
